en-US.name: PC Control
en-US.summary: Control your PC with Alexa – wake up or shut down your computer.
en-US.description: Use voice commands to power on or shut down your PC remotely. Requires the Alexa PC Control backend running on your network.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask PC Control to shut down my computer
Alexa, ask PC Control to turn on my PC
Alexa, ask PC Control to reboot

es-ES.name: Control PC
es-ES.summary: Controla tu PC con Alexa – enciéndelo o apágalo con tu voz.
es-ES.description: Usa comandos de voz para encender o apagar tu ordenador de forma remota. Requiere el backend de Alexa PC Control funcionando en tu red.
examplePhrases: Alexa, dile a Control PC que apague el ordenador
Alexa, dile a Control PC que encienda el PC
Alexa, dile a Control PC que reinicie

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Enable the skill and say 'Alexa, ask PC Control to shut down my computer'.
